sn55.42:1.1: Cattāro me bhikkhave puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā sukhassāhārā || katame cattāro || || Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti- || Dhamme || Saṅghe || || Vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāram ajjhāvasati ||
sn55.42:3.1: muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato || ayaṃ catuttho puññābhisando sukhassāhāro || || Ime kho bhicattāro puññā- kusalābhisandā sukhassāhārā
sn55.42:6.1: Mahodadhim aparimitaṃ mahāsaraṃ || bahubheravaṃ ratnāgaṇānam ālayaṃ || Najjo yathā naragaṇasaṅghasevitā || puthusavanti hi upayanti sāgaraṃ ||||
sn55.42:7.1: Evaṃ naram annapānavatthadadaṃ || seyyānisajjattharaṇassa dāyakaṃ || puññassa dhārā upayanti paṇḍitaṃ || najjo yathā vārivahā va sāgaran ti
